title: Осторожность научного вывода
description: Соразмеряем силу утверждения данным и не подменяем ограниченный результат универсальным правилом.
objectives: Различать may suggest и conclusively proves
notes: May suggest указывает на возможный вывод; conclusively proves заявляет гораздо большую силу доказательства.
Оговорка о выборке меняет область применимости вывода и не равна признанию полной бесполезности исследования.

options.label: The tool is proven to improve productivity in every organisation.
The results offer tentative evidence of a benefit in the tested setting.
The researchers have demonstrated that scheduling tools never work.

public_payload.passage: A small company tested a new scheduling tool with twelve volunteers from one department. Most participants reported that planning their week became easier, but there was no comparison group and the test lasted only a fortnight. The researchers wrote that the findings “may indicate a practical benefit in this setting”. They deliberately avoided claiming that the tool would improve productivity in every organisation. A larger sample would not automatically remove every limitation: differences in roles and the absence of a comparison group would still require attention. The cautious wording therefore reflects the design of the study rather than a desire to conceal an unfavourable result.

exercises.editorial_answer: The results offer tentative evidence of a benefit in the tested setting.
exercises.explanation: Ограниченная добровольная выборка без группы сравнения поддерживает лишь осторожный контекстный вывод.

public_payload.sentence: These preliminary observations ___ that further investigation is worthwhile.

exercises.explanation: May suggest сохраняет предварительный характер наблюдения.

public_payload.sentence: The findings should be interpreted ___ caution.

exercises.editorial_answer: The findings should be interpreted with caution.
exercises.explanation: With caution — с осторожностью; without caution означало бы противоположный подход.

exercises.prompt: Переведи осторожный вывод, не усиливая его.

public_payload.source: Результаты могут указывать на связь, но не доказывают причинность.

accepted: The results may indicate an association, but they do not prove causation.
The findings may suggest an association, but they do not demonstrate causation.

exercises.reference_answer: The results may indicate an association, but they do not prove causation.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The results prove that one factor causes the other.
exercises.editorial_answer: The results may indicate an association, but they do not prove causation.
exercises.explanation: Association — связь; causation — причинность. Оговорка об отсутствии доказательства обязательна.

exercises.prompt: Выбери две формулировки с явно ограниченной областью вывода.

options.label: The pattern must occur in every population.
In this sample, the pattern was observed twice.
The findings may not generalise to other settings.

exercises.editorial_answer: In this sample, the pattern was observed twice.; The findings may not generalise to other settings.
exercises.explanation: In this sample и may not generalise явно ограничивают область применимости.

exercises.prompt: Ответь коллеге, который чрезмерно обобщил результат.

options.label: No result can ever provide any useful information.
The evidence is promising, but the design does not support that broad a claim.
Exactly; twelve volunteers prove every possible outcome.

public_payload.context: So this proves that the tool will work for everyone, doesn’t it?

exercises.editorial_answer: The evidence is promising, but the design does not support that broad a claim.
exercises.explanation: Первый ответ признаёт ценность данных и ограничивает силу вывода без другой крайности.

exercises.prompt: Согласуй глагол с множественным findings, сохранив осторожность.

public_payload.sentence: These findings suggests that the approach may help.

accepted: These findings suggest that the approach may help.

exercises.reference_answer: These findings suggest that the approach may help.
exercises.incorrect_answer: These findings prove that the approach always works.
exercises.editorial_answer: These findings suggest that the approach may help.
exercises.explanation: С findings нужен suggest. Замена на prove и always необоснованно усиливает вывод.

exercises.prompt: Выбери ближайший синоним tentative для вывода.
exercises.explanation: Tentative и provisional обозначают предварительный характер; conclusive означает окончательный.
